hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling in Jacksonville From an Employee-Owned Team
hero.subheadline: Woodsman designs kitchens, installs cabinets, cuts quartz and granite countertops in its own Jacksonville shop and lays new floors. Since 2023 the company has been 100% owned by its employees.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling Jacksonville area project in Ponte Vedra: soft blue Shiloh shaker cabinets, brass hardware, a white quartz island and wood counter stools

intro.h2: The parts of a kitchen that matter most, done in-house
paragraphs: Woodsman Kitchens & Floors has offered kitchen remodeling in Jacksonville since 1983, starting as a small cabinetry supplier on the First Coast. The company is not a full-service general contractor. It focuses on design, cabinets, countertops and flooring, and it does those parts itself.

Quartz and granite tops are cut and polished in the company's own Jacksonville warehouse, which keeps quality and lead times in local hands. In September 2023 the business became 100% employee-owned, so the designer, the fabricator and the installer in your home are all part owners. The goal is a custom-looking kitchen without a custom price tag.

services.h2: Design, cabinets, counters and floors from one showroom

items.name: Kitchen Design
items.blurb: In-house designers plan your layout and cabinets, pair countertops with backsplashes, coordinate flooring and help choose colors. The service also covers bathrooms, laundry rooms and new builds. Design support is included when you choose products through Woodsman, with no third parties or commissions.

image.alt: Warm transitional kitchen in Coastal Oaks with stained wood and eggshell painted cabinetry and a large island

items.name: Cabinets and Installation
items.blurb: Cabinet lines include Shiloh, Aristokraft, Eclipse, Diamond Vibe and Kitchen Craft, in custom and budget-friendly options. Installers tear out old cabinets, then set kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities and built-ins level and aligned, working hand in hand with the designers who drew the plan.

image.alt: Ponte Vedra kitchen with black Shiloh inset cabinets, a reeded walnut island, arched details and gold-veined quartz

items.name: Quartz and Granite Countertops
items.blurb: Woodsman offers quartz and granite only, measured, cut and polished at its local fabrication facility and installed by its own team. Keeping fabrication in-house gives the company control over quality and scheduling, which makes the countertop install smoother and lead times more consistent.

image.alt: White shaker kitchen with a marble-look quartz island, stainless appliances and beaded globe pendant lights

items.name: Flooring
items.blurb: Hardwood, luxury vinyl plank, laminate and tile for kitchens and living spaces, chosen from the showroom displays and installed by the same company that builds your kitchen. Matching floors to the cabinets and counters is part of the design work, so the whole room is planned together.

image.alt: Bright open-concept Jacksonville home with new light wood-look flooring running from the dining area into the kitchen

items.name: Bathroom Vanities and Baths
items.blurb: Bathroom remodeling and vanities with the same cabinet lines, quartz and granite tops and design help used in kitchens. Finished projects include a primary bath in Julington Creek, a bathroom refresh in Ponte Vedra Beach and coastal baths with built-ins in Atlantic Beach.

image.alt: Bright primary bathroom with light wood vanities, white countertops, a freestanding tub and a glass walk-in shower

why_choose_us.h2: Why First Coast homeowners pick Woodsman

items.title: Owned by the people who do the work
items.text: Since September 2023 the company has been 100% employee-owned through an ESOP. The people designing, cutting and installing your kitchen are owners with a stake in getting it right.

items.title: Countertops cut in Jacksonville
items.text: Quartz and granite slabs are fabricated in the company's own local warehouse, not shipped out. That gives Woodsman direct control of quality and keeps lead times consistent.

items.title: Design help without a designer fee
items.text: In-house designers guide every selection, and their support is included when you buy your products through Woodsman. The company promises prices below big box stores on expert design and quality materials.

items.title: Techs who treat your home with care
items.text: Google reviewers praise service techs like Joel, Jimi and Curtis for arriving on time, wearing shoe covers, and showing owners how to care for their cabinets after the job.

about.h2: A Jacksonville company owned by its employees
about.text: Woodsman began in Jacksonville in 1983 as a small cabinetry supplier and grew into one of Northeast Florida's known names in kitchens, baths and flooring, with more than 200,000 jobs completed. In September 2023 it became 100% employee-owned. Brad Mangold serves as president and Ira Cloud as vice president, and designers such as Ann-Marie Kallio, with the company since 2014, guide clients through selections. Woodsman belongs to the Jacksonville Chamber of Commerce, the Northeast Florida Builders Association, the Florida Home Builders Association and the NAHB, and local builders rely on it too.

image.alt: Woodsman Kitchens & Floors employee-owners gathered in the company's Jacksonville warehouse

process.h2: How kitchen remodeling in Jacksonville works with Woodsman

steps.title: Visit the showroom
steps.text: Look for the big purple W on Beach Blvd. Full kitchen vignettes, cabinet lines, slabs and flooring are on display six days a week.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: A designer learns your needs, style and budget, then plans the layout, cabinets, countertops and flooring around how you live.

steps.title: Fabricate
steps.text: Your materials are ordered to the approved design, and countertops are cut and finished for your space in the local fabrication shop.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Installers tear out old cabinets, then set new cabinets, countertops and floors with careful attention to fit, function and detail.

steps.title: Service after the job
steps.text: Service techs come back for adjustments and repairs, and reviewers say they explain how to clean and care for your cabinets.

service_area.text: From the showroom at 11732 Beach Blvd, Woodsman serves homeowners and builders in Duval, St. Johns, Clay, Nassau and Baker counties. That covers Jacksonville and the beaches, Ponte Vedra, St. Augustine, Amelia Island and Yulee. Recent finished projects sit in Ponte Vedra, Jacksonville Beach, Atlantic Beach, San Marco, Julington Creek and Coastal Oaks. Not sure your area is covered? Call and the team will check.

faq.h2: Good to know before you visit Beach Blvd

items.a: No. Woodsman says plainly that it is not a full-service general contractor. It handles kitchen design and layout, cabinet installation and tear-outs, quartz and granite fabrication and installation, and flooring. That covers everything from a cabinet-only upgrade to a complete kitchen transformation within that scope.

Woodsman offers quartz and granite only, and many tops are fabricated locally in the company's Jacksonville warehouse. Cutting and polishing slabs in-house lets the team control quality and keep lead times consistent, and the fabricators work directly with the designers and installers on your job.

items.q: Which cabinet brands can I see in the showroom?
items.a: The showroom displays Shiloh, Aristokraft, Eclipse, Diamond Vibe and Kitchen Craft cabinetry in a range of styles, finishes and price points. You can compare door styles and colors side by side, then sit down with a designer to plan the layout.

items.q: Do I pay extra for a designer?
items.a: Design support is included when you choose your products through Woodsman. You work directly with in-house designers, not third parties paid on commission, and they help with layout, cabinet style, countertop and backsplash pairing, flooring and color selection for kitchens, baths and laundry rooms.

The Beach Blvd showroom is open Monday through Friday from 8:30 am to 5:00 pm and Saturday from 10:00 am to 2:00 pm, and closed Sunday. Walk in to browse, or schedule a design consultation so a designer is ready for you.

final_cta.h2: Start with a visit to the big purple W
final_cta.text: Call (904) 641-8336 or stop by 11732 Beach Blvd to meet a designer and see the slabs, cabinets and floors in person.

current_site_defects: Measured: Google PageSpeed mobile performance score 37, the slowest in this group.
The home page hero is a background video; in the crawl it renders as 'Video is not available or format is not supported. Try a different browser.'
75 of 210 site images have no alt text, including most finished-project photos on the portfolio pages.
FAQ answers (financing, free design consultations, timelines, areas served) are collapsed and not in the page text, so search engines and quick readers see only the questions.
The 4.5 Google rating from 286 reviews is not shown on the home page; the site testimonials are signed only '-Misti', '-Lakewood' and '-Wynn'.
In the hours block the text order reads 'Saturday / Sunday / CLOSED / 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM', which can make Saturday look closed to screen readers and some visitors.
No email address is published; contact is phone or form only.
what_this_homepage_fixes: Keyword H1 and title on 'kitchen remodeling Jacksonville', with the 286-review Google rating and 1983 founding in the hero.
Tap-to-call (904) 641-8336 at the top and bottom; a still Ponte Vedra kitchen photo replaces the failing background video.
States the scope honestly (design, cabinets, countertops, flooring; not a general contractor) and answers the key FAQs in text.
Turns the ESOP and in-house fabrication into the main proof points instead of footer links.
Every gallery photo gets descriptive alt text with the neighborhood where the site names it (Ponte Vedra, Sawgrass, Coastal Oaks).
